info.title: soldi
info.description: Personal-finance thermometer API. Authenticate with the `__Host-soldi_session` cookie (`soldi_session` over plain HTTP). Money is a decimal string. Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.

202.description: Accepted whether or not an account has this e-mail; when one has, a reset link valid for 1 hour is e-mailed to it and older links stop working

422.description: Field `email` over 254 bytes

204.description: Password set; every session and every pending reset link of the user end

422.description: `invalid-reset-link` for an unknown, expired or used token; field `password` when the new one has not 8 to 128 characters

200.description: Signed in; sets the session cookie

401.description: `invalid-credentials`, the same for an unknown email and a wrong password

204.description: Every session of the caller revoked, this one included; cookie cleared

201.description: Signed up and signed in; sets the session cookie. Settings and default categories are created

200.description: Unarchived recurring bills by due day, then name

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: A `bill` entry outside any series that becomes this bill's payment, moved to its category

404.description: The `transaction_id` entry is missing or another user's

422.description: Name not 1 to 100 characters, amount not above zero or with more than two places, missing on a conta fixa or present on a card (`amount`), `closing_day` not 1 to 31, due day not 1 to 31, `category_id` not one of the caller's active bill categories or, on a card, `Economia` or a cofrinho, or `cannot-become-bill` when the entry is not a `bill` entry, already a bill's payment, a resgate or a series member

204.description: Archived: out of every list and month; its payments stay

404.description: Missing, already archived or another user's

200.description: The bill after the change; absent fields stay as they are

422.description: Same rules as create, on the bill after the change; `closing_day` on a conta fixa, `active: false` on a card; `fatura-paid` when a card's `closing_day` changes while a fatura from this month on is paid (D30b)

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The month being paid, `YYYY-MM`; `date` must fall in it

404.description: Missing, paused, archived (a card stays payable) or another user's

409.description: Already paid in the date's month (`bill-already-paid`)

422.description: `date` outside `month`, `month` not `YYYY-MM`, `amount` missing on a card, amount not above zero or with more than two places, or a date before the opening date (`before-opening-date`)

204.description: The month's payment entry is deleted

404.description: Not paid that month, or another user's bill

422.description: `month` is not `YYYY-MM`

parameters.name: include_system
parameters.description: Also list `Resgate`, the income category of withdrawals from a cofrinho

200.description: Active categories, flat: income, bills, then daily; within a kind by parent name, each parent followed by its subcategories by name; a subcategory of another kind than its parent sits in its own kind's section

404.description: `parent_id` is missing, archived or another user's

409.description: An active category of the same kind has this name

422.description: A bad field, a parent on the other side (income vs outflow) or a non-bill under `Economia`, `nested-subcategory` when the parent is a subcategory, `savings-category` under `Resgate`, `not-a-cofrinho` for a target or deadline outside `Economia`, `color-taken` when the color is taken in any kind the group shows in, or `palette-full` when no color is given and all 24 are taken in the kind

204.description: Archived with its subcategories: they leave the list, their entries keep them

422.description: `savings-category` for `Economia` or `Resgate`, `cofrinho-not-empty` for a cofrinho holding money

200.description: The category after the change; absent fields stay as they are; a new `kind` moves this category and its own entries; its subcategories keep theirs

404.description: The category or `parent_id` is missing, archived or another user's

409.description: An active category of the same kind has this name; `duplicate-name` when the new `kind` already holds this category's name

422.description: A bad field, `kind-locked` for a `kind` on `Economia`, a cofrinho, `Resgate` or an income category or a `kind` of `income`, `category-has-bills` when moving to `daily` a category an unarchived conta fixa (active or paused) uses, `category-has-card-entries` when moving to `bill` a category with entries on a card, a parent on the other side (income vs outflow) or a non-bill under `Economia` or itself, `nested-subcategory` when the parent is a subcategory or this category has subcategories, `savings-category` when moving `Economia` or `Resgate` or under `Resgate`, `not-a-cofrinho` for a target or deadline outside `Economia`, `color-taken` when the color is taken in any kind the group shows in, or `palette-full` when moving to top-level without a color, or changing a top-level's `kind`, and all 24 are taken in the kind

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The month of `saved_this_month`, `YYYY-MM`; this month in São Paulo when absent

200.description: Every cofrinho with its balance, goal and next repeated deposit

422.description: `month` is not `YYYY-MM`

200.description: Its entries and resgates, `Economia`'s with its subcategories', newest date first, then newest entry first

422.description: `limit` out of range, or `not-a-cofrinho`

201.description: The resgate: an income entry in `Resgate` with `cofrinho_id`

422.description: A bad field, `insufficient-cofrinho` above the balance, `before-opening-date`, or `not-a-cofrinho`

200.description: Every day from today (the opening date, when later) to the end of the 11th month after today's, with every unpaid bill landed (D16, D17)

204.description: Account and every row of it deleted; cookie cleared. The e-mail can sign up again

422.description: `wrong-password`; nothing deleted

429.description: Rate limited with the password-change budget; wait `Retry-After` seconds

422.description: `name` blank, over 60 characters or with NUL

204.description: Password changed; every other session of the caller is revoked, this one stays

422.description: `wrong-password` for a wrong current password; field `password` when the new one has not 8 to 128 characters

204.description: `tour_seen` is true from now on; calling again changes nothing

200.description: Every calendar day with its balance and tier, carried from the opening balance

422.description: `month` is not `YYYY-MM` from 2000 to 2100 (`validation`), or is before the opening date's month (`month-before-opening`)

200.description: Opening balance saved, bills created, `onboarded` is true

422.description: Fields named like `bills[0].amount`; nothing is saved

200.description: The month's outflow and income by category, each against the previous month; resgates are not income

422.description: `month` is not `YYYY-MM`

200.description: Each month's income and savings, as the month view, from the opening month to December, newest first; months after today's are a `forecast` of their entries, out of the totals; empty before the opening or after today's year

422.description: `year` is not a year from 2000 to 2100

200.description: The settings after the change; absent fields stay as they are

422.description: Money with more than two places, tiers out of order (names the upper tier of the first pair), an unknown field

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only this category's entries; another user's category lists nothing

200.description: The month's entries: newest date first, then newest entry first

400.description: No `month`, or `category_id` is not a UUID

422.description: `month` is not `YYYY-MM`

201.description: The entry; with `repeat_months` or `installments`, the first of its series (parcela 1), the rest written in the same database transaction

404.description: The category is missing, archived or another user's

422.description: Amount not above zero or with more than two places, note over 500 characters, `card_id` on a non-`daily` entry or not one of the caller's unarchived cards, a kind other than the category's (`category_id`), `repeat_months` not 2 to 60, `installments` not 2 to 60, with `repeat_months`, or leaving a parcela at zero, a date outside 2000 to 2100, a date before the opening date (`before-opening-date`), or `fatura-paid` when a spend on a card lands in an already paid fatura (D30b)

200.description: Deleted the caller's entries dated in the period, bill payments and resgates included; nothing else changes
The caller's entries dated in the period, bill payments and resgates included

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `following` also deletes the series' members dated after this one

422.description: `archived-cofrinho`: the entry, or with `following` a later series member, is a deposit into or a resgate from a deleted cofrinho; `fatura-paid`: the entry, or with `following` a later series member, is a card spend of a paid fatura (D30b); nothing is deleted

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `following` also writes the amount, kind, category and note onto the series' later members, and a new day of the month onto this and every later member, each clamped to its month; the month never spreads

200.description: The entry after the change, with the series' new total; absent fields stay as they are

404.description: The entry is missing or another user's, or the new category is missing, archived or another user's

422.description: Same rules as create, on the entry after the change, `before-opening-date` included (an archived card it already carries stays allowed); with `repeat_months`, `repeat-not-allowed-on-bill-payment` or `repeat-not-allowed-on-cofrinho-withdrawal` on an entry outside a series, `validation` on `repeat_months` outside 2..60 or below this member's position, on `date` when the series would pass 2100; with `following` on a series member, `validation` on `date` when the new date leaves this entry's month (`must stay in this entry's month when the series moves`) or when two of the moved members share a month (`must not move a series with two entries in one month`); `archived-cofrinho` when the entry, or with `following` a later series member, is a deposit into or a resgate from a deleted cofrinho; `fatura-paid` when the amount, date or card changes on a card spend whose fatura (or, with `following`, a later member's) is paid, or the change lands it in a paid fatura (D30b); nothing is written

Bill.description:
A recurring bill, or with `closing_day` a credit card (D28). `due_day` 29 to 31 falls on the
last day of a shorter month.

amount.description: Always set on a conta fixa, never on a card.

closing_day.description: Set only on a card: a spend dated before it (clamped) closes this month's fatura.

BillOfMonth.description:
An active recurring bill in the month. `amount` is what was paid, or the bill's amount while
unpaid; `due_date` clamps a late due day to the month's last day; `overdue` is unpaid with
`due_date` before today in São Paulo. In the current month, a bill still unpaid in an earlier
month is listed again first, with that month's `due_date`, `overdue` and `lands_on` today (D17).
A card's row is its fatura (D28): unpaid, `amount` sums the spends due that month; a card
month without spends or payment is not listed.

lands_on.description:
The day an unpaid bill enters the projection: its due date, or today once due; null when
paid or when that day falls after the month.

Category.description:
`icon` is a lucide icon name; `color` a palette token, `cat-1` to `cat-24`, unique among the
active top-level categories showing in a kind (their own or a subcategory's) and the parent's on
a subcategory; `parent_id` the
category this one is a subcategory of, null for a top-level one. `is_savings` marks the
user's `Economia` (bill) and `Resgate` (income); `target` and `deadline` belong only to
cofrinhos, the subcategories of `Economia`.

CategoryGroup.description:
A top-level category with its subcategories' amounts rolled in: `amount` and `previous_amount`
add its own entries and its subcategories'; `pct` is its share of the outflow or income total.
`children` are the subcategories with entries in the month, largest first; `kind` is the
top-level category's own, whatever its subcategories' kinds.

CategoryReport.description:
`outflow` (bills and daily) and `income`, each by amount, largest first; `groups` the same
month by top-level category, outflow groups then income groups, each by amount.

Cofrinho.description:
A subcategory of `Economia`, or `Economia` itself as `Sem objetivo` (`parent`). `balance` is
its entries minus its resgates since the opening date; `progress_pct` is `balance / target`
with one decimal, capped at 100, null without a target; `done` is a balance at or above the
target; `monthly_suggestion` is what is left over the months to the deadline, this one
included, null without a deadline or when done; `next_contribution` is the earliest member
dated after today of a repeated entry into it, null without one.

Cofrinhos.description:
`total_saved` sums every balance; `saved_this_month` is the requested month view's `totals.saved`.
Items go done last, then by name; `Sem objetivo` only while its balance is above zero.

token.description: The `token` of the link in the e-mail.

amount.description: A conta fixa's: greater than zero, up to two decimal places. Absent on a card.

category_id.description: One of the caller's active `bill` categories.

closing_day.description: 1 to 31; makes the bill a card, which then has no `amount`.

CreateCategory.description:
`icon` defaults to `circle-dashed`; `color`, `cat-1` to `cat-24`, to the lowest token free in
the kind. `parent_id` makes it a subcategory of one of the caller's active top-level categories
on the same side: income under income, `daily` or `bill` under either outflow kind, only `bill`
under `Economia`. For a subcategory `color` is validated, then ignored: it wears its parent's
color; a parent whose color is taken in the child's kind moves to the lowest token free in every
kind it shows in, or keeps it when none is.

target.description: Greater than zero; only for a subcategory of `Economia`.

amount.description: Greater than zero, up to two decimal places; never rounded.

card_id.description: One of the caller's unarchived cards; only on a `daily` entry.

category_id.description: One of the caller's active categories.

installments.description:
2 to 60 monthly parcelas splitting `amount`, the total: each `amount / n` truncated to
cents, the last takes the remainder (D16); dated like `repeat_months`; not with it.

note.description: Up to 500 characters; blank means none.

repeat_months.description:
2 to 60 entries, this one included, on the same day of the following months (the
month's last day when shorter); absent means just this one.

Currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency every amount is shown in.

Day.description:
One calendar day: what came in and went out, and the balance at its end. `income` leaves
resgates out; `withdrawn` holds them, and the balance adds both.

projected_balance.description:
`balance` minus the unpaid bills landed on or before this day (`BillOfMonth::lands_on`);
equal to `balance` before today and in a past month.

DeletedTransactions.description: How many of the caller's entries a period deletion removed.

Forecast.description:
`days` run from today (the opening date, when later) through the last day of the 11th month
after today's, São Paulo (D13); empty when the opening date is past that.

ForecastDay.description: One day ahead (D16): the balance with every unpaid bill landed, and its tier.

MonthSavings.description:
The month's savings (SOL-20): `saved` is `totals.saved`; `rate_pct` is `saved / income` as a
percentage with one decimal, null when income is 0.

MonthView.description:
`month` is `YYYY-MM`. `balance_today` is the balance at today, or at the month's last day
when the month is past. `projected_balance` is, for the current and a future month, the last
day's `projected_balance` (every unpaid bill landed, earlier months' included); for a past
month, the balance at its end minus its unpaid `bills_of_month`.

NextContribution.description: A repeated entry's next deposit: its amount and the day of the month it falls on.

opening_balance.description: What the user has today; may be negative.

PayBill.description: `amount` defaults to the bill's amount and is required for a card; the bill never changes.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details, the body of every error response.

SavingsMonth.description:
A month of the savings year: `income` without resgates, `deposited` (bills under Economia and
its cofrinhos), `withdrawn` (resgates) and `saved`, `deposited` minus `withdrawn`, as the month
view's `totals.income` and `savings.saved`.
`rate_pct` is `saved` over `income` with one decimal, null when `income` is 0. `forecast`
marks a month after today's: only the entries already dated there, out of the year's totals.

SavingsYear.description:
A year's savings month by month, newest first, from the opening month (or January) to
December; totals and `rate_pct` are over the months up to today's, not the forecast ones.

Scope.description: Which entries of a series a change or a deletion reaches; `this` when absent.

Settings.description:
Money is a decimal string with up to two places (`"-500.00"`). The tiers are the lower
bounds of the thermometer colors and are strictly increasing:
`tier_red < tier_zero < tier_yellow < tier_green`.

name.description: Defaults to the part of the e-mail before `@`.

Tier.description: The thermometer color of a balance; each lower bound is inclusive.

Totals.description:
`income` leaves the month's resgates out, `withdrawn` sums them (SOL-28); `outflow` is bills
plus daily; `performance` is income minus outflow; `saved` is the bills under `Economia`
minus `withdrawn`, already inside `bills`.

Transaction.description: `category` is the entry's category as it is now, archived or not.

card_id.description: The card a Diário spend went on; it weighs on the balance with the card's fatura (D28).

cofrinho_id.description: The cofrinho a resgate took money from.

recurring_bill_id.description: The recurring bill this entry pays, if any.

oneOf.description: The repeated run this entry belongs to, if any.

TransactionCount.description: How many of the caller's entries a period holds.

TransactionSeries.description: Entries sharing `id` were launched together by `repeat_months`; counted at read time.

last_date.description: The date of the series' last member; growth continues in the months after it.

UpdateBill.description:
Absent fields stay as they are. `active: false` keeps the bill out of the month; a card has
no pause. `closing_day` changes only on a card.

UpdateCategory.description:
Absent fields stay as they are; `kind`, `daily` or `bill`, moves this category alone, top-level
or subcategory, with all its entries to that kind; its subcategories keep theirs (D27). A
top-level keeps its color when free in every kind it then shows in, else takes the lowest free
one; a subcategory's group may recolor the same way. The savings categories, cofrinhos and
income ones never change kind. `"parent_id": null` makes it top-level, with `color` or the
lowest token free in the kind. For a subcategory `color` is validated, then ignored: it wears
its parent's; a parent's new color reaches its subcategories. A move under a group can recolor
that group and its subcategories to a color free in every kind it shows in. `null` clears
`target` or `deadline`, which only a subcategory of `Economia` may set. Leaving `Economia`
clears both.

UpdateSettings.description: Absent fields stay as they are.

UpdateTransaction.description: Absent fields stay as they are; `"note": null` clears the note, `"card_id": null` the card.

card_id.description: A new card must be one of the caller's unarchived cards; keeping an archived one is fine.

repeat_months.description:
How many entries the series counts, 2 to 60: starts a series from an entry outside one,
or adds or removes members at the end of this entry's series (never one dated before it).

onboarded.description: False until `POST /api/onboarding` runs; the web shows onboarding while it is false.

tour_seen.description: False until `POST /api/me/tour-seen` runs; the web shows the welcome tour after onboarding while it is false.

Withdraw.description: Takes money out of a cofrinho as an income entry in `Resgate`.

amount.description: Greater than zero, up to two decimal places, at most the balance.

note.description: Up to 500 characters; blank means none.
